_comment: GENERATED by scripts/fetch-ebird.mjs. Do not edit by hand. The Delaware species list and taxonomy come from the eBird API (Cornell Lab of Ornithology) and are reference data, not sightings. Nothing in this file asserts that a bird is present today — see /birding/ for how seasonality is handled and why live observations link out instead. IT IS ALSO NOT THE SAME THING AS DELAWARE'S OFFICIAL STATE LIST: that is maintained by the Delaware Ornithological Society records committee on its own criteria, and the two numbers do not match. Cite whichever you mean, by name.

source.label: eBird API 2.0 — Cornell Lab of Ornithology
